findings.claim: The brief template that step 3 tells the model to fill has no `change-name` slot. The brief header (line 31) has no field for it, and the Project-Inception Handoff table (lines 106-108) has no change-name column. S2(a) requires the slug in both places. The rewritten entry still states the requirement (SKILL.md:20, 34), but the commit also removed the old 'in every row of the Project-Inception Handoff table' wording. The template does not carry the requirement either. The S2(a) pin reads only the entry text and the inception-pipeline sentence. It never checks the template, so a brief written from the template can drop the slug and still pass.

findings.claim: The S2 pin test reads the consumer side for only some contracts. For (a), (b), (c), (d) it reads inception-pipeline, project-inception, closure-feedback and tier-selection. For (e), the clarify-request brief and prespec transcript input, it checks only the entry text. For (c) and (f) it never reads pre-sdd-contracts.md, which S2 names as the owner of the brief shape and the English rule. A rewording in clarify-request or in pre-sdd-contracts.md would therefore go unnoticed. The S2 text and the L2 test design ask for both sides to be read where the consumer text is readable.
